name: Shiraoka (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Shiraoka city emblem in navy: a ring of concentric arcs with a small disc at the top, enclosing a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Shiraoka, a city in Saitama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 13 April 1955.

features.role: Shiraoka city emblem — a ring of concentric arcs with a small disc at the top, enclosing a stylised character
